description:
Get Google News Results

Retrieves Google News results by free-text query, topicToken (World, Business, Technology, etc.), sectionToken, publicationToken (e.g. CNN, BBC), or storyToken (full-coverage cluster with sort by relevance/date). Returns article title, snippet, source publisher, published date, thumbnail, and URL, plus tokens for navigating topics, sub-sections, and story clusters. Use for news monitoring, brand/PR tracking, topical aggregators, publisher-specific feeds, and drilling into full story coverage.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

publicationToken.description: Token for a specific publisher such as CNN or BBC. Not allowed with `q`, `storyToken`, or `topicToken`.

q.description: Free-text query as used on news.google.com. Not allowed with `topicToken`, `storyToken`, or `publicationToken`.

sectionToken.description: Token for a sub-section under a topic, for example Business → Economy. Use only when `topicToken` or `publicationToken` is present.

so.description: Sort order for articles in a story. Use only with storyToken.

storyToken.description: Token for a single news story cluster (the “Full coverage” page).

topicToken.description: Token for a Google News topic such as World, Business, or Technology. Not allowed with `q`, `storyToken`, or `publicationToken`.
